note: SOLID STAMP's settings. Stamps are driven by exact matches to SFO-BBs only; these settings shape the digest and its delivery, never which TNLDY stamps. eps: the variac, in X units at REVOTT's 100 days (0.00005 = ±7.2 min about Z). clock and domains: REVOTT STAMPS' own (reconciled clock; the six domains of its standing requests, plus prediction markets, added at the author's word on 2026-11-22). settle_minutes: how long after the window closes the digest waits for late items. final_hours: when the final stamp is recorded (not pushed). horizon_hours: how far ahead alerts are scheduled on the ntfy server (its limit is 72). priority: ntfy priority per class (1 min, 2 low/silent, 3 default, 4 high, 5 max); every class is pushed, and every match is in view (3 or higher), as the author asked on 2026-11-11. items_in_message: feed items shown in the notification (all are on the digest page). page: the SOLID STAMP site, once published; stamps_page: REVOTT STAMPS. sender: where the alerts and digests are sent from, laptop (this computer's cron) or github (the Actions workflow); the other place sends nothing. lookback_days: how far back an unsent digest is still sent. morning_resend: from 'at' each morning, every digest first sent between night_from (the evening before) and night_until is sent again under its sequence ID, because a phone in deep sleep can miss a message. digest_min_priority: every digest goes out at no less than this priority; at 4 ntfy.sh hands it to Firebase as urgent ('high'), which reaches a phone in deep sleep.
